brief: Holds a JSON document as a Ring list, as an object of keys or an array of items, and records its mistakes instead of raising them.
detail: Built from a JSON text or from a Ring list. An object is read and changed by key (HasKey, Value, SetValue, RemoveKey, TakeKey) and an array by position (At, Add, Insert, RemoveAt, TakeAt ...). A call that does not fit the kind of JSON held, or an index outside the array, leaves the object unchanged and records a message in LastError. Writing an array that holds anything back to text fails today (ToString, Copy, Show, Print): see their warnings.
